submissions.title: Crusoe Announces New 900 MW AI Factory Campus in Abilene, Texas to Support Microsoft AI Infrastructure
submissions.excerpt: By integrating 900 MW of new on-site power generation, we will continue building the industrial foundation for American AI
submissions.note: AUDIT: tracker records 900 MW as one undifferentiated figure (LOW confidence) and frames Microsoft as only 'reported in talks' per a secondary DCD piece — vs Crusoe's own press release, which names Microsoft as the confirmed customer and states the 900 MW is ON-SITE POWER GENERATION, not IT load (two buildings at 336 MW each = 672 MW combined IT load). Recommend: (1) update tenant status from rumored to confirmed, (2) split the metric into ~672 MW IT load vs 900 MW site/generation power rather than one undifferentiated number — this is exactly the site-power/IT-load conflation error class, (3) raise confidence now that a primary source exists.

claims.methodology: Crusoe's own 2026-03-27 press release. Basis: site power / on-site generation — NOT IT load. Critical IT capacity is separately reported as ~672 MW (2 buildings x 336 MW) in the same release; not submitted as a separate claim here because no standalone <25-word quote for that sub-figure was captured — flagging for the reviewer to pull from the same source.
